mechanics: 100-Ki Strike counter Super used by Cooler (Final Form) and obtainable through his training. The user holds a counter stance for about one second; if struck by a Ki Blast during the window, they rush to the opponent and perform a hard-knockdown strike. Current skill evidence reports about 20% damage and specifies that the counter reacts to Ki Blast-based attacks rather than melee attacks; exact counter-window frames remain unresolved.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
